mc-sandbox · Developer testing

Sandbox privacy notice

This notice describes the current mc-sandbox prototype prepared by Interleaf Development to evaluate matching test bank transactions with sample tuition invoices.

Test data

Use fictional records and bank-provided sandbox accounts only. Do not enter real student or parent details, upload real bank statements, or use production banking credentials.

Current storage and connection

The MathConcept demo stores its simulated workflow data in the browser's local storage. This data does not synchronise between devices. The demo does not currently retrieve bank transactions.

The callback page is a setup placeholder. It discards incoming authorisation parameters and does not store them in browser storage or exchange them for access tokens.

Hosting

The site is hosted on Vercel. Ordinary hosting and security logs may contain request details such as the requested URL, IP address and time. The sandbox pages do not add analytics or advertising scripts.

Removing demo data

Use Reset in the demo, or clear this site's browser storage, to remove locally saved demo records. Updates to bank connectivity or data handling require this notice to be reviewed before those features are used.
